title: 電気電子コンピュータ工学
subtitle: Computer architecture for Electrical and Electronic Engineers
educationalGoal: This course intends to study on basic technologies for computer design and utilization for electrical engineers. This course lectures on dual aspects, e.g. hardware and software. Students can understand whole of basic technologies to make use of computers without hesitation after their graduation, because all of industrial fields need engineers with basic knowledge of computers.
advice:
Major topics in this course are listed as follows.

(1)Background of computer technologies
- History of computer, Neumann type computer
(2)Computer architecture and implementation (Hardware aspect)
- Logical circuit and its operation, CPU architecture, Machine language
(3)Introduction of high level language
- Summary of typical programing languages, basic syntax of C language
(4)Computer architecture and implementation (Software aspect)
- Assembly language, High level language, Operating systems, Computing algorithm
(5)Latest topics in computer R&D by a guest lecturer
- Latest technical trends, Methodology of hardware and software development in the industrial company
requiredKnowledge:
Students should understand the following basic knowledge.
- Product image with CPU
- Digital circuit and devices
- Roughly image of OS and programing language

activityGoals.body: Understanding position and function of machine, assembly and high level languages
Understanding configuration and processing flows of CPU
Understanding configuration of peripheral devices focusing on storage devices
Understanding objectives and functions of OS

achievementLevels.ideal:
Students can explain following items with precision.
-Key functional blocks in a computer and operations among these blocks
-Simple program codes by machine, assembly and high level languages
-Configuration and processing flows by assembly language in CPU
-Functions of OS with some examples
-High performance computing technology with some examples
Through these knowledges, students can design A Simple Computer (ASC) which is an educational reference model.
achievementLevels.standard:
Students can explain roughly following items without hesitations
-Key functional blocks in a computer and operations among these blocks
-Simple program codes by machine, assembly and high level languages
-Configuration and processing flows by assembly language in CPU
-Functions of OS
-High performance computing technology
